hfzy_set.title: Huangfu misc features
hfzy_set.desc: The play button, RSS name priority, filtered count, RSS copy fix, filter-hit marks, adult TMDB titles, typed season priority, revision detection, and revision conflicts can be set separately.
hfzy_set.rss_episode_count: Show filtered versions and videos after the season
hfzy_set.rss_episode_count_desc: Count release versions and videos left in the current RSS after filters.
hfzy_set.rss_copy_fix_desc: Copy the full RSS link from the icon when the page is opened over http.
hfzy_set.rss_filter_hit_desc: Draw an orange box around a filter tag when its pattern matches an RSS title.
hfzy_set.tmdb_include_adult_desc: Include titles TMDB marks as adult when searching TV and movies. Turn this off to leave them out.
hfzy_set.rss_form_season_desc: When collecting or subscribing, the season in the dialog wins over the season in the filename. A file marked season 3 is still downloaded as the season you typed. Every season in that RSS is saved under that season.
hfzy_set.revision_group_fallback: Recognize a higher revision in brackets
hfzy_set.revision_group_fallback_desc: A [v2] tag is revision 2. When the release group contains a space and was not parsed, the first bracket is used so it can be compared with the unmarked release.
hfzy_set.revision_single_video: A subtitle archive is not a second episode
hfzy_set.revision_single_video_desc: Automatic replacement counts videos only. A subtitle or font archive, ass, or srt beside the episode does not make it a multi-file torrent.
hfzy_set.revision_conflict_policy_desc: What happens when a higher revision, such as 01v2, targets an episode that already has a file. Hold keeps the old file and records a conflict. Replace swaps in the newer revision.
